data.name: Karthikeyan
data.gender_notes: Karthikeyan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Karthikeyan is the god of war, son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati. He is also known as Murugan, Subramanya, or Skanda. He is worshipped for his courage, leadership, and victory over evil. The name Karthikeyan carries the meaning “God of War” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Karthikeyan usually hope their child will grow to embody god of war and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength, courage, and the victory over inner struggles and external adversities.
data.etymology: Karthikeyan belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of War.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karthikeyan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: Ganesha is a widely revered deity in Hinduism and is invoked at the beginning of any new venture or important endeavor as a symbol of good luck.
data.spiritual_significance: Ganesha represents the removal of obstacles and the granting of wisdom and knowledge to the seeker. He is the remover of sorrows and the bestower of happiness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Karthikeyan is the name of Lord Murugan, the god of war, wisdom, and love. He is the embodiment of courage, knowledge, and devotion, guiding his followers towards spiritual growth and victory over inner challenges.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Karthikeyan is the name of the Hindu god Murugan or Subramanya. The name Karthikeyan carried significant spiritual weight in that era.

trends: Popular in Tamil Nadu, South India
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Karthikeyan is derived from the Tamil language and is popular in the South Indian state of Tamil Nadu. It is the name of the Hindu god Murugan or Subramanya, who is also known as Karthikeya. The name is often used as a personal name in Tamil Nadu and can be found on social media platforms.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted individual named Arjun Karthikeyan in Kathmandu, Nepal attributes much of their spiritual journey to their name Karthikeyan, which means "God of War". They believe their name has guided them on the path of righteousness.
